expect_red: a session correction leaves one standing binding, the corrected one, and one earlier

mutations.contract: The browser's fold hides the superseded binding and keeps it as history, as build_projection does.
mutations.note: Without the move a corrected binding keeps standing and the row shows both ends bound. The fold moved to apps/viewer/identity_fold.js on 2026-11-12 (one fold for both apps); AA.addEventToRecord delegates to it.
mutations.find: if (event.supersedes) row.bindings = take(row.bindings, standingId(row, event.supersedes), row.superseded).kept;
